notes.cnPur: -(으)려고 + verb states a purpose ('in order to'), and -는데/-(으)ㄴ데 sets a background or a mild contrast.
notes.cnAnd: -고 lists actions or qualities in order ('and').

notes.prePres: -는 척하다 means 'pretend to (do)' for present verbs and 있다/없다; use -(으)ㄴ 척하다 after adjectives and 이다.
notes.prePast: To pretend to have done something already, use the past -(으)ㄴ 척하다 on a verb.
notes.preNeg: Negatives work inside the pretense: 안 + verb or -지 않다 become 안 V는 척 or V지 않는 척.

notes.rgForm: Verb stem + -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요 expresses regret about something you did not do ('I should have ...').
notes.rgNeg: Use -지 말 걸 그랬어요 to say 'I shouldn't have ...' about something you did.
notes.rgIrr: The ㄹ ending of 말다 stays as 말 before 걸; ㄷ- and ㅂ-irregular stems change before -(으)ㄹ.
